normalization: NFKC, lowercase, yo->ye, Unicode alphanumeric tokens; no number expansion

wer.ordering: segment start then end; overlap may make sequence WER ambiguous

der.reason: Independent reference and raw hypothesis diarization required; ASR chunk times are not speech boundaries

reference.license: Dialogs OpenRAIL; copy of full terms in LICENSE.md; recipients must comply with Section 2

recurrence_probe.method: dominant eligible cluster per source clip; not speech-boundary truth

evaluation_scope: Three composed acted utterances from external test.csv; not natural conversation or a representative corpus benchmark
